items.title: Xi Jinping lands in the US for a state visit
items.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping and his wife, Peng Liyuan, landed at Joint Base Andrews and were greeted by Donald and Melania Trump ahead of a state visit to the White House. The White House's arrival video got 20K likes, and a clip of Trump wincing at the military flyover while Xi stood still drew a 160K-like quote: "Absolutely mogged".
items.author: @WhiteHouse

post.name: The White House
post.text: President Donald J. Trump and First Lady Melania Trump greet President Xi Jinping of China and Madame Peng Liyuan upon their arrival in Washington, D.C., ahead of the state visit at the White House.
